title: Tecan Cortisol ELISA with Heater Shaker
author: Boren Lin
materials: Nunc 96-Well Polypropylene Storage Microplates (Cat. #: 249947, Thermo Fisher, Waltham, MA, USA) or compatible
The supernatant in each well is discarded.

steps.title: Seal ELISA plate
steps.instruction: Seal the 8‑well strip ELISA plate with a slit seal before handling.

steps.title: Place plate on heater shaker
steps.instruction: Place the sealed ELISA plate on the Heater Shaker Module and close the latches to secure it.

steps.title: Add samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 50 µL of each saliva sample into the corresponding well of the ELISA plate.

steps.title: Add enzyme conjugate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of HRP‑conjugated cortisol (Enzyme Conjugate) to each well.

steps.title: Incubate with agitation
steps.instruction: Agitate the plate on the Heater Shaker at 500 rpm for 120 minutes (2 hours).

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Remove and discard the supernatant from each well.

steps.title: Wash wells
steps.instruction: Perform four washes total: add 250 µL Wash Buffer to each well, then discard the supernatant; repeat the add‑and‑discard cycle three additional times.

substeps.instruction: Add 250 µL Wash Buffer per well.
Repeat add‑and‑discard three more times (total of 4 washes).

steps.title: Add TMB substrate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL TMB Substrate Solution to each well.

steps.title: Develop color
steps.instruction: Agitate the plate at 500 rpm for 30 minutes to allow color development.

steps.title: Add stop solution
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL Stop Solution to each well to halt the reaction.

steps.title: Read plate
steps.instruction: Open the Heater Shaker latches, transfer the ELISA plate to a microplate reader, and measure absorbance at 450 nm.
